description: Translate the opening Team Cute scene and directions for the Chibickmon search.

english:
Big sis? Do you
mean Akari?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
No, I don't
think I've ever
called Akari
that. Besides,
she's in the
Commander Room
right now. It
must be someone
they met in
this Zone.
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
We asked around
to see if
anyone had
spotted
Chibickmon.
Someone said
they saw it
near East
Knuckle City,
but it
disappeared
soon after, so
we don't know
where it went.
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
East Knuckle
City...? You
mean near East
Knuckle Coast?
That's close to
where we fought
Pukumon.
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
All right,
brother! Let's
go find
Chibickmon!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
You left it to
me?!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
L-left it to...
me?! Huh?! Hey,
wasn't I
supposed to go
first?!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
Without that
little one, the
Pickmons are a
mess... Leave
it to us! We'll
find it right
away!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
Come on, Taiki!
We have to save
Chibickmon!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
Wait a minute,
Taiki! If
you're going to
East Knuckle
Coast, take
this!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
What... What
kind of key is
this?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
It's the key to
the gate near
East Knuckle
City. Past that
gate is
Twisting
Amazon. If you
can't find
Chibickmon at
East Knuckle
Coast, will you
search the
neighboring
Twisting
Amazon, too?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
Twisting
Amazon, huh?
Got it. We'll
look there,
too.
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
What the heck?!
We just came
through here!
We're going
round and round
in the same
place!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
Big sis, round
and round!♪
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
That's why you
should call me
Lady
Minervamon! And
since you've
joined Team
Cute, you have
to... add
'meow' before
and after you
speak! You
understand?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
Meow! Yes,
meow!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
Aaaah! There
they are!
Chibickmon...
and who are
those guys?
What are they
doing?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
Um... don't ask
me... But they
look like
they're having
fun. Maybe
they're not bad
Digimon?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
Hey, you!
Dangerous bad
boys are
coming! Hurry
up and run!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
D-danger...
meow? Bad
boy...?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
Shut up! Stand
up! And hurry
up!!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
M-meow! Yes,
meow!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
Ah! They got
away...
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
Let's chase
them, Taiki!
We'll catch up
in no time!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
The whirlpools
here are
one-way. Once
you enter one,
you can't
return through
the whirlpool
you came from.
Be careful!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
We can hide
here for a
little while...
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
...We can hide
here!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
Round and
round... round
and round...
meow?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.

english:
If there's a
hole, I have to
hop in! Let's
skedaddle,
meow! You
understand?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue translated directly from Japanese. Character names, zone names, and Team Cute follow the project style.
